definitions.mean_query_total_latency_ms: Operational per-question latency with method-specific preparation amortized across the benchmark questions for one target.
definitions.mean_query_continuation_latency_ms: Per-question online question-answering latency after any method-specific build/optimization artifact is already ready. For full/truncation this still includes prompt prefill for that question; for STILL/cartridge it means querying with the prebuilt compact cache already loaded.
definitions.mean_target_preparation_seconds: One-time cost to prepare one held-out target before answering its benchmark questions.
definitions.one_time_reusable_training_seconds: Reusable training cost paid once across targets. Applies only to STILL.
definitions.mean_target_total_seconds: Mean target preparation plus all benchmark-question inference for one held-out target, excluding STILL reusable training.

notes: Cartridges has no reusable training stage. Its expensive cost is per-target optimization and must be paid again for every new corpus/page.
STILL separates one-time reusable compactor training from per-target cache build.
Truncation still reprefills roughly the retained long context on every query, while STILL reuses a compact cache and only runs the short continuation online.
Decode length also affects observed latency. This benchmark now logs raw decoded text and generated token ids so normalized single-letter MCQ answers can be audited.
